Synopsis:
Eskom's CFO Calib Cassim, a 24-year veteran who was instrumental in the utility's operational turnaround and return to profitability, will retire before end of FY March 2027. Eskom aims to name a successor by end of calendar year 2026. Cassim expressed confidence in continuity of the recovery trajectory.
